name: volt-rtk-extension
description: Rewrite bash tool calls through RTK for token-optimized command output.

volt.description: Rewrites bash commands through RTK for token-optimized command output.

enabled.title: Rewrite commands
enabled.description: Rewrite bash commands through rtk. Off: commands run unchanged.

rewriteTimeoutMs.title: Rewrite timeout (ms)
rewriteTimeoutMs.description: How long one rtk rewrite may take; a command whose rewrite takes longer runs unchanged.
